# Konstantin Zavarov — https://zavarov.com/

> Konstantin Zavarov's blog about product management

## About the author

Konstantin Zavarov is Head of Product at Ozon with 12+ years of experience in IT. Previously worked at Yandex, Megamarket, and Kaspersky Lab. Taught product management courses at Yandex Practicum from 2021 to 2025. Runs the «Код Продакта» Telegram channel (https://t.me/pmgen). Original content is in Russian; English pages are AI-translated.

## Articles

- [The Brand Age, Paul Graham](https://zavarov.com/en/brandage/): Reflections on Paul Graham's essay 'The Brand Age': why technological advantage is finite, and when betting on brand becomes a matter of survival.
- [Product Strategy ≠ Template](https://zavarov.com/en/product-strategy/): There's no universal product strategy template. On what strategy actually looks like in practice — and why it's a living system, not a document.
- [Second Brain: PARA × Obsidian × Granola × Claude](https://zavarov.com/en/second-brain/): How to build a knowledge management system from PARA, Obsidian, Granola, and Claude — and why it works like a second brain.
- [People Who Write Interestingly](https://zavarov.com/en/people/): A curated list of authors who write compelling content on product-related topics and are worth returning to.
- [ICE, RICE, DRICE Prioritization Frameworks](https://zavarov.com/en/drice/): A detailed breakdown of the ICE, RICE, and DRICE task prioritization frameworks: formulas, examples, and a comparison of approaches.
- [10 Deadly Sins of a Junior Product Manager](https://zavarov.com/en/10-evils/): 10 key mistakes that junior product managers make, which hold back professional growth and hurt business performance.
- [Thinking Through Writing](https://zavarov.com/en/text/): How Amazon's document-centric culture develops critical thinking, and why the ability to work with text matters for product managers.
- [Books and Resources for Product Managers](https://zavarov.com/en/pm-materials/): A curated list of the best books, courses, and resources for developing product management skills. Regularly updated.
- [The Evolution of Goal-Setting Frameworks: From OKR to NCT](https://zavarov.com/en/nct/): The evolution of goal-setting frameworks: from MBO and OKR to NCT — Ravi Mehta's framework that could replace OKR.
- [Product CEO: How a Product Manager Creates Meaning and Communicates Value](https://zavarov.com/en/pm-ceo/): How a product manager creates meaning and communicates the value of a product to the business, the team, and users.
- [Tools and Services for Product Managers](https://zavarov.com/en/pm-tools/): Sharing the tools I use for product development, business processes, and personal productivity
- [The Growth Dilemma of Online Course Economics](https://zavarov.com/en/edtech/): Why the economics of online courses don't scale well, and what the growth dilemma looks like for edTech companies in the Russian internet market.
- [Product Management Is Marketing Management](https://zavarov.com/en/kotler/): Why a product manager is essentially a marketing specialist, and how this understanding changes the approach to product management.
- [Loyalty ≠ Satisfaction](https://zavarov.com/en/nps-csi/): Why loyalty and satisfaction are different concepts, and how to measure them correctly using NPS and CSI.
- [On Leadership](https://zavarov.com/en/leader/): What leadership is, why it matters, and where to start if you want to develop the skill of positively influencing people.
- [Calculating Classic, Rolling, and Full Retention in Python](https://zavarov.com/en/retention/): A hands-on guide to manually calculating 3 types of Retention metrics using Python and Pandas, and plotting a Retention curve with Matplotlib.
- [Chart Templates for Data Visualization](https://zavarov.com/en/template-diagrams/): A Google Sheets template with reference chart examples for visualizing product, business, and financial data.
- [The Zettelkästen Note-Taking Method](https://zavarov.com/en/zettelkasten/): The increasingly popular note-taking method from the extraordinarily productive German sociologist Niklas Luhmann.
- [How to Run a Retrospective for a Large Team](https://zavarov.com/en/retrospective/): A detailed 8-step plan with timings for running an engaging retrospective with a large team (10+ people).
- [A/B Test Design Template](https://zavarov.com/en/template-abt/): A Google Sheets template for designing A/B tests: hypothesis formulation, sample size calculation, and experiment duration.
- [ICE, RICE, DRICE Prioritization Framework Template](https://zavarov.com/en/template-rice/): A Google Sheets template for prioritizing product initiatives using the ICE, RICE, and DRICE methods.
- [On Getting Certified as a Certified Scrum Product Owner](https://zavarov.com/en/cspo/): What to expect from CSPO training and certification — beyond just another badge to collect.
